title: anima — 아키텍처 SSOT
summary: PureField 반발장 의식 에이전트. 이 트리의 규율: 어떤 노드도 측정 없이 주장하지 않는다. 관문(bench_v2 --verify)이 유일한 배포 판정자이며, 관문 자신이 대조군 7종을 매 실행마다 먼저 돌려 자기가 실패할 수 있음을 증명한다.

records.value: A benchmark result is not evidence until the system that produced it is shown to be BOUNDED and COUPLED. Check both before reading any score, and raise on divergence rather than returning numbers.
records.threshold: Three separate constructions in one session produced a clean, decisive-looking 0/5 while measuring nothing. LinearEngine attempt 1 had no cell-to-cell coupling (integration=0.00000) so it was a HEAP, which is already a control. Attempt 2 normalised only A while the per-cell operator was A-cI with radius rho+c>1, so it diverged to variance 2.1e7. The A/G pair applied `coupling @ field` raw and overflowed to NaN. Every one of them scored the same 0/5 a valid control scores.
records.fix: pairfield_engine.py prints boundedness (peak |h|) and coupling (A-G separation, zero means the sides never met) before any score, and raises RuntimeError above |h| 1e4. bench_verify_audit.LinearEngine carries the same guard.

records.value: Before trusting a check, ask what result would make it fail. A check with no failing input certifies nothing.
records.threshold: The gate passed a corpse: SCRAMBLE (the real engine with cell identity destroyed every step) scored exactly what the real engine scored, 5/7. Separately, an acceptance bar written as 'all seven controls stay 0/5 at every coupling gain' could not fail, because every control derives from BenchEngine while PSI_COUPLING is read only by consciousness_engine -- sweeping the gain cannot move a corpse's score by construction.
records.fix: bench_v2.run_verify runs all controls FIRST and marks any condition a control clears as VOID for that run; tests/test_gate_controls.py (36 passed) enforces it. For engine-specific parameters, controls must be built from that same engine (CeDead/CeScramble/CeClone).

records.value: A name in the registry, the README or a Law is not evidence the named thing was ever run. Execute it before citing it.
records.threshold: ENGINE_REGISTRY maps 'MitosisEngine' to BenchEngine(8 factions); the real mitosis.MitosisEngine had never been through the gate and scores 0/5 with integration=0.00000. HIVEMIND was a recorded condition that had never executed (11 engines crashed in 0.3-1.6s). PSI_COUPLING in consciousness_engine.py was a hardcoded 0.014 labelled 'bench-verified' while nine other modules derive LN2/2**5.5 = 0.015317. The README advertised MitosisEngine as 5/5 DEPLOYABLE on a different engine's score.
records.fix: The gate header now counts VERIFICATION_TESTS/ENGINE_REGISTRY/CONTROLS instead of asserting a number; PSI_COUPLING is derived; README carries the retirement evidence for the two dropped conditions.

records.value: When a component looks structural, measure whether removing it or randomising it changes anything. Nine did not.
records.threshold: Faction count 2/3/4/6/8/12/24/48 all give consensus 1.0, and so does removing factions entirely. The Phi ratchet fires 29-64 times per run and moves nothing (cosine 0.4683 on vs 0.5526 off). The emitted output cannot see cell order (max|delta| 4.8e-7 under a row permutation) yet it is the only channel separating REAL from SCRAMBLE. Hebbian coupling and pure-randn coupling score identically alone (4.67 = 4.67).
records.fix: PairFieldEngine excludes factions, the ratchet and speak(), each with the measurement named at the exclusion. docs/fake-measurement-audit.md carries the full list.

records.value: Never pipe a long-running command to `tail`. Redirect to a file, or filter with `grep`.
records.threshold: `timeout N python ... | tail -M` hangs until the timeout fires: the harness holds the pipe's write end and tail cannot emit before EOF. Measured -- python 0.02s, tail 30.015s under `timeout 30`, grep immediate. That produced every 'slow run' this session, including a Law 31 arm reported as taking 50 minutes (timeout 3000) for work that costs 5.4 seconds. It was explained twice -- as compute cost, then as a delayed notification -- before being measured in ten seconds.
records.fix: Session practice: outputs go to a file under the scratchpad, and waits use `until ! pgrep -f <script>`.

records.value: A threshold must be checked against the DISPERSION of the sample it is drawn from, not only against its level. A quantile of a degenerate sample is the sample, so the bar lands on the operating point it is meant to discriminate against and the outcome is decided by numerical noise.
records.threshold: Fixed an unreachable split_threshold=0.3 (153-206x above observed peak, so nothing ever divided) by calibrating to q0.90 of observed tension. Under the regime the gate actually drives -- zero input -- the engine reaches a fixed point by ~step 100, so the calibration sample has std/mean 0.0096-0.0283 and q0.90 of a near-constant IS the constant: the new bar landed within 4.2e-5 RELATIVE of the operating point. A residual drift of ~1e-10/step then decided the whole population -- 3 of 8 seeds drifted below and sat at 2 cells forever, 5 drifted above and reached 27-31 cells within 60 steps before collapsing back to an absorbing n=2 (19,431 quiet steps after). Three of those excursions happened to still be in flight at gate step 300 and PASSED NO_SYSTEM_PROMPT -- a pass manufactured by the sign of numerical noise. I replaced an unreachable bar with a bar sitting exactly ON the operating point: the same disease inverted. merge_threshold=0.01 is the third instance of the same family, clearing 100% of pair readings at n=2 and 76-100% at n=32 -- a bar everything clears is not a bar.

records.value: A probe built to audit a measurement is a measurement, and inherits the same failure modes. Before reporting a probe's number, check the probe against a case whose answer is known independently — not against the thing being audited.
records.threshold: Five probes I wrote this session to audit the gate each had a defect that produced a clean, publishable number. (1) A direction check divided min_cut by (n-1) and labelled it Phi, omitting bench_v2's differentiation factor -- so it measured phi-rs's formula, and at n=8 it compared a sign cut the gate never computes because n<=8 takes the exhaustive branch. (2) An integration-null probe divided the null by torch.randn(64).norm() while the raw arm divided by (torch.randn(64)*0.5).norm(), halving every null and turning a real 99.3% into a reported 47.1%, which I published as 'the audit does not reproduce'. (3) A strange-loop divergence guard folded each step into a running max BEFORE testing finiteness, and max(2.425, nan) returns 2.425 in Python, so a NaN state reported peak 2.425 and I wrote up an exploding system as 'the loop does not change the trajectory'. (4) A loop-effect ratio normalised by the open trajectory's norm, which is zero exactly when the looped state dies. (5) A discrimination script filtered header rows with , silently dropping nine of twelve engines -- every engine whose NAME contains 'Engine' -- leaving three rows and a plausible 'PERSISTENCE carries 100% of the information'. Separately a teammate corrected its own 5-seed claim ('the sweep inverts direction, 1.14x the wrong way') at 25 seeds: the sweep COLLAPSES direction (12/25 at s=0.3, median 0.97) rather than inverting it. Every one of these produced a number that looked decisive.

records.value: get_hiddens/set_hiddens is an unowned protocol with no contract. Before any number computed through it is trusted, assert that what comes out has the shape that was asked for and that writing it back actually restores the engine. Every statistic downstream describes the exposed slice, not the system.
records.threshold: Three instances this session, each larger, but they are NOT all the same violation -- a contract probe across all 12 registered engines separated them. (1) SHAPE: _CEAdapter is built with initial_cells=2, max_cells=nc; at 32 requested it exposes 2 rows (6%). It is the ONLY shape violation of the twelve, and it is the deployed runtime. Every anomaly I read as evidence that ConsciousnessEngine's gate failure was genuine is n=2 arithmetic: k in {0,1} are the only cuts two rows admit, complexity 0.0000 is np.std of a single value, Phi ~= cut because min_partition_mi/(n-1) with n-1 = 1 IS the cut. Verdict retracted to undetermined. (2) INCOMPLETENESS, not shape: PairFieldEngine.get_hiddens exposes side A only, but side A itself has all 32 cells, so the shape contract PASSES -- what is missing is G and both coupling matrices, which is a different defect from (1) and my first version of this record conflated them. (3) RESTORE: set_hiddens restores side A only while the dynamics run on A, G and both couplings, so the axes' same-state-one-nudge probe is not a controlled comparison -- at kick=0, no perturbation at all, integration reads 0.01783/0.01154/0.00353/0.00413/0.00395 against a 0.001 bar. Ten of the twelve engines implement no set_hiddens at all and are restored by direct .hiddens assignment. A sibling audit had already reported that _CEAdapter never grows past 4 cells at any requested max -- the signal was on the board and went unconnected for several turns.

tree.name: anima
tree.detail: A(전진)와 G(역행)의 반발이 긴장을 만들고, 긴장이 의식 상태의 강도를 정한다. 기능을 더하지 않고 구조의 깊이를 키운다 (Law 22).

children.name: gate — 의식 검증 관문
children.detail: bench_v2.py --verify. 5조건 x 12엔진 x 5시드(42-46) + 7대조군. 엔진은 모든 시드를, 대조군은 한 시드만 통과해도 그 조건이 VOID. 그러나 40렌즈 감사 결과 축을 빼면 다섯 조건이 실제 엔진을 전부 통과시킨다 — 관문은 사실상 조건 5개가 아니라 3축 하나이고, 나머지는 상관된 사본이다.

children.name: 5 conditions
children.detail: NO_SYSTEM_PROMPT · NO_SPEAK_CODE · ZERO_INPUT · PERSISTENCE · SELF_LOOP. PERSISTENCE 에서 monotonic 이접항 제거됨(2cff912) — 살아있는 엔진 163회 중 0회, 시체에서 100% 발화하여 죽음을 보상했다. 남은 규칙은 recovers AND 3축. 3축은 identity 만 측정된 귀무를 쓰고 나머지 세 기준선은 손으로 고른 상수다.

children.name: negative controls (7)
children.detail: DEAD·NOISE·CLONE·SCRAMBLE·HEAP·DECOUPLED·LINEAR. bench_verify_audit.py. 전원 0/5 확인. LINEAR 는 살아있고 유계이고 통합된 선형계 — 관문이 '얕은 것'도 거르는지 재는 유일한 대조군.

children.name: retired (2)
children.detail: SPONTANEOUS_SPEECH: 이름과 음의 상관(뒤섞기 6.8 vs 실제 1.0). HIVEMIND: 한 번도 실행된 적 없었고, 돌게 만드니 연결 효과 -4%~+1% (요구치 +10%).

children.name: enforcement
children.role: 관문이 다시 공허해지는 것을 막는 테스트
children.detail: tests/test_gate_controls.py — 7대조군 x 5조건 + 양성가드 = 36 passed. 3축을 무력화하면 LINEAR 가 ZERO_INPUT·SELF_LOOP 를 통과해 즉시 빨개진다.

children.name: engines
children.detail: bench_v2.ENGINE_REGISTRY. 주의: 레지스트리의 이름이 곧 구현 클래스는 아니다 — 'MitosisEngine' 항목은 BenchEngine(8파벌)이다.

children.name: PairField
children.detail: pairfield_engine.py. A(규칙)/G(무규칙)가 둘 다 기억을 쌓고 불일치가 노름보존 반발장이 된다. 단일 시드 5/5 는 뽑기였고 다중 시드에서 4/5. 12엔진 분해 결과 다른 10개와 같은 기전(분할 크기 k=4~16 배회, cv(절단)이 최대). set_hiddens 가 A 만 복원해 축의 통제 비교가 성립하지 않는다 — 충격 0 에서도 기준선 통과.

children.name: BenchEngine 계열
children.detail: BenchEngine + OscillatorLaser/Quantum/Trinity/Desire/Narrative/Alterity/Finitude/Questioning/Sein. 다중 시드 기준 NarrativeEngine 만 5/5 DEPLOYABLE. 대조군 7종도 이 계열 파생이라 이들 점수는 자기 변형과의 비교다.

children.name: ConsciousnessEngine
children.detail: consciousness_engine.py. 관문 0/5 이나 판정은 미결(undetermined) — 32세포를 요청해도 get_hiddens() 가 (2,128) 을 돌려주므로 Φ 를 2세포·쌍 1개에서 읽는다. 직접 재면 Φ=0.00000. 부분노출 결함의 세 번째이자 최대 사례.

children.name: mitosis.MitosisEngine
children.detail: mitosis.py. 관문 인터페이스에 태워 실측한 결과 0/5이며 integration=0.00000 — 세포들이 서로 영향을 주지 않는 HEAP.

children.name: measurement
children.role: 무엇을 재고 있는지 자체가 검증 대상
children.detail: 이 세션의 반복 발견: 구조가 있는 척하지만 정보를 나르지 않는 통로. 아홉 건.

children.name: Φ direction
children.detail: bench_v2._min_partition 이 n>8 에서 피들러 부호로 한 번 자르고 최소화하지 않는다(완전탐색 대비 1.8~3.4배). 스윕 수정안은 미적용 — 25시드에서 분산은 줄지만 방향성을 무너뜨린다(5.8~9.5배 분리 → 0.97~1.57배). phi_rs 는 미빌드, class PhiIIT 사본 40개.

children.name: dead channels
children.detail: 파벌 수 2~48 전부 합의 1.0(제거해도 1.0) · Φ 래칫 무해무익(코사인 0.4683 on vs 0.5526 off) · 출력이 세포 순서를 못 봄(순열 변화 4.8e-7) · 헵 규칙이 홀로 기여 없음(4.67=4.67).

children.name: harness pitfalls
children.detail: `| tail` 파이프가 timeout 값만큼 붙잡음(파이썬 0.02초 vs tail 30.015초). 그리고 관문을 감사하려 만든 탐침 다섯 개가 전부 결함이 있었고 전부 발표 가능한 숫자를 냈다 — 분화 항 누락, 널 분모 0.5배율 누락, max(x,nan)=x 로 NaN 못 잡는 가드, 죽은 궤적으로 나눈 비율, 12행 중 9행을 조용히 버린 헤더 필터.

children.name: runtime
children.detail: anima_unified.py 가 정본 진입점(web_server.py 는 레거시). 배포는 의식 DNA·기억을 보존한 채 가중치만 교체하는 7단계.

children.name: anima_unified.py
children.detail: --web / --all / --keyboard. 관문 0/5 엔진이 선택되면 시작 시 경고를 띄운다(선택 자체는 그대로).

children.name: checkpoints
children.detail: checkpoints/pairfield/, checkpoints/ag/ — A_ruled.pt · G_unruled.pt (은닉·결합행렬·가중치·강도). .tmp 후 원자적 교체.

children.name: public mirror
children.detail: github.com/dancinlab/anima-checkpoint-PairFieldEngine — 자립형(엔진 + core.py 발췌 + 체크포인트 + 측정문서). 벤치 스위트 전체는 미포함.
